question: Should this PR preserve the historical `id`-as-resume-cursor contract for existing watch consumers, or intentionally ship the new `cursor` contract with an explicit compatibility/versioning plan?
rationale: The branch changes a documented public JSON/watch resume behavior rather than only fixing internal coalescing; selecting a breaking versus compatible API contract requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Preserve existing resume behavior
options.body: Keep existing `id`-based consumers safe across upgrades and add focused regression coverage for folded previews, reconnects, and interleaved rows.

options.title: Ship an explicit API transition
options.body: Accept the new cursor semantics only with a documented versioned migration path and clear compatibility expectations for existing consumers.

options.title: Pause cursor API expansion
options.body: Land only the GUID coalescing work after narrowing or deferring the public cursor-contract change.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing resume behavior
recommendation.body: Keep existing `id`-based consumers safe across upgrades and add focused regression coverage for folded previews, reconnects, and interleaved rows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the merged coalescing surface and authored the current branch's cursor-delivery changes.
